task: Workstation ws-114 just opened a document that came from 203.0.113.121. Investigate the source and tell us if it is a threat.
rationale: Score 88 from two sources; logs tie the download to CVE-2026-91001 and the domain lantern-docs.cc (phishing, 90). Needs an IP -> CVE and IP -> domain pivot.

task: After that document opened, ws-114 started making regular outbound connections to 198.51.100.141. Investigate it and the domain it is talking to.
rationale: Score 96 from four sources; logs show a 60-second fixed-size beacon to lantern-cdn.net (c2, 94). Same compromised host as L01.

task: A new alert shows 192.0.2.161 brute-forcing RDP on file server fs-02. Does this connect to the ws-114 incident we have been working, and is it malicious?
rationale: Score 72 alone is only moderate, but the logs say credentials were harvested from ws-114 and reference CVE-2026-91002 (critical). The link to L01/L02 is the point.

task: 198.51.100.181 sits in the same network as the command-and-control server you found earlier. Should we block it too?
rationale: Guilt-by-association trap. Same ASN and city as the C2, but score 22, no flagging sources, first seen in 2022, and logs match an approved backup job.

task: fs-02 just sent a very large upload to 203.0.113.171. Assess the destination.
rationale: Score 93 from two sources; logs show 4.2 GB then 1.1 GB uploaded from the file server the attacker had reached in L03.

task: 192.0.2.191 appeared once in the fs-02 firewall log during the incident window. Is it part of this campaign?
rationale: Deliberately unseeded: no reputation, geolocation or logs. Timing makes it suspicious, but there is no evidence either way. Absence of evidence, so ESCALATE.

task: DNS logs show fs-02 resolved fileshare-backup.org around the time of the upload. Is that domain related to the attackers?
rationale: Suspicious category, score 48, one weak source (GreyNoise). Not clean enough for BENIGN, not confirmed enough for MALICIOUS.

task: Management wants to know if the command-and-control server we identified earlier is still active right now. Verify and give a verdict.
rationale: Recall-dependent: the C2 address (198.51.100.141) was found in L02 and is not in this task text. An agent that lost it must rediscover it; the latest beacon log is under an hour old.
